title: 縦型バンドソー
description: 地域の整備工房やメーカースペース用の縦型バンドソー。上下の車輪ハウジングを左の背骨フレームでつなぎ、開いた喉部、差し込みスリットと刃の穴を持つ作業台、定規フェンス、短く見える静止帯刃、ガイド、上部調整輪、正面スイッチ、後部モーター外装と中空の集じん口を造形しています。材料、切断動作、内部の駆動輪や配線は含みません。電気・機械・荷重支持・安全性は未検証の静的な外観モデルで、操作・製作の指示は付属しません。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.784 × 1.726 × 0.805 m、11,900三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A vertical band saw for municipal workshops and makerspaces. Separate upper and lower wheel housings connect through a left backbone around an open throat. Includes a slotted work table with real blade aperture, straight fence, short stationary visible band, guides, top adjustment wheel, front switches, rear motor exterior and hollow dust outlet. No stock, cutting action, internal drive wheels or wiring is included. Static appearance geometry with no electrical, mechanical, load-bearing or safety validation and no operation or fabrication instructions. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.784 × 1.726 × 0.805 m; 11,900 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
